targetConcentration.note: An alias key is UNIQUE by index, so the alias path can never report AMBIGUOUS. Its uniqueness is a property of the index, not an observation about the corpus, and almost every candidate here arrives on it.

guardNote: Readability is EVIDENCE on the candidate, never a block. The generator refuses a candidate only when the source text is absent, because text_quality is known to score unreadable documents above its own floor and a guard built on it would refuse good sources while admitting damaged ones.
